records.title: History of the Wars; Buildings; Secret History
records.corpus_boundary: Three principal works remain separate bodies; Wars requires all eight books and must not imply coverage of Buildings or Secret History.

original_route.candidate: Dewing Greek text in the six-volume Loeb lineage surfaced by Perseus.

english_route.candidate: Dewing translation, 1914–1928, with all eight Wars books; separate candidates required for the other works.

records.next_action: Inspect the five Wars volumes and separately identify Buildings and Secret History files.

findings.proposition: Perseus identifies Dewing as editor and exposes all eight books of De Bellis.
The Perseus catalog identifies the bilingual Dewing edition, publishers, dates, and five-volume Wars division.

unresolved_risks: Perseus access does not settle bulk portability.
No file has been inspected or admitted.
Public-domain status remains jurisdiction- and edition-specific.

records.title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum
records.corpus_boundary: The five-book Ecclesiastical History only; Latin critical text, Sellar translation, notes, and later revisions are distinct layers.

original_route.candidate: Plummer Latin critical text, to be located in a stable institutional scan.

english_route.candidate: A. M. Sellar revised translation, George Bell, 1907, Project Gutenberg ebook 38326.

records.next_action: Inspect Gutenberg plain text and locate an exact Plummer Latin scan.

findings.proposition: Gutenberg identifies Sellar, ebook 38326, text formats, and public-domain status in the United States.
Sellar states that her 1907 translation uses Plummer's Latin text and revises the Giles/Stevens lineage.

unresolved_risks: English is not an original-language equivalent.
Gutenberg's rights statement is US-specific.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Magna Carta reissue tradition
records.corpus_boundary: The 1215 settlement and the 1216, 1217, 1225, and 1297 reissues are separately modeled texts; modern clause numbering and surviving statutory force are annotations, not original features.

original_route.candidate: National Archives 1215 Latin charter image and transcript route; later reissues require separate witnesses.

english_route.candidate: National Archives 1215 English translation with explicit reissue markers.

records.next_action: Verify National Archives reuse terms and build a version ledger through 1297.

findings.proposition: The National Archives dates the agreement to 15 June 1215 and supplies a full English translation.
The National Archives marks clauses repeated in 1225 and clauses omitted from every later reissue, and notes that the original has no clause numbers.

unresolved_risks: Repository-wide Crown copyright and Open Government Licence applicability must be verified for the exact files.
The 1215 translation cannot stand for later reissues.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Tarikh al-rusul wa-l-muluk
records.corpus_boundary: The historical chronicle only; the Tafsir and other works are excluded. Arabic print recensions and the SUNY English series are separate bodies.

original_route.candidate: A complete de Goeje-lineage Arabic scan remains to be verified volume by volume.

english_route.candidate: SUNY/Yarshater complete English series, 1985–1999, plus index; documented for reference only.

records.next_action: Create a volume ledger for the de Goeje Arabic edition and verify repository rights.

findings.proposition: SUNY describes the complete English translation as thirty-nine translated volumes completed in 1999 plus a 2007 index.
BnF catalogs an individual SUNY History of al-Tabari volume, supporting series identity rather than open reuse.

unresolved_risks: No reusable complete English body is known.
Arabic volume completeness and scan rights are unresolved.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Muqaddimah
records.corpus_boundary: The Muqaddimah as the introductory book of Kitab al-Ibar; later abridgments and Rosenthal's translation are separate bodies.

original_route.candidate: Quatremere's 1858 Arabic edition, pending exact multi-volume scan and rights inspection.

english_route.candidate: Rosenthal's complete English translation for reference only; no admissible English body verified.

records.next_action: Inspect and reconcile every Quatremere volume, then locate a lawful historical English translation if one exists.

findings.proposition: Open Library identifies a Quatremere Arabic-edition record for the Muqaddimah.
A complete modern English route is not portable merely because bibliographic or lending access exists.

unresolved_risks: Edition record and downloadable files have not been reconciled.
The English route is restricted.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Siyar al-muluk / Siyasatnama
records.corpus_boundary: The fifty-chapter received work, preserving the disputed thirty-nine-plus-eleven composition history and authenticity questions.

original_route.candidate: Schefer's 1891–1897 Persian/French edition for historical comparison; Darke's later Persian edition is restricted.

english_route.candidate: Darke 1960/1978 translations for reference only; no admissible English file verified.

records.next_action: Locate and inspect all Schefer volumes and encode the Darke manuscript corrections as non-equivalent.

findings.proposition: Iranica records the thirty-nine-chapter core plus eleven appended chapters and preserves the authorship dispute.
Iranica identifies Schefer's 1891–1897 edition and Darke's later revised Persian and English editions.

unresolved_risks: Schefer used poor manuscripts and cannot silently represent the later critical state.
Modern English is restricted.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Kitab fi tahqiq ma li-l-Hind
records.corpus_boundary: Kitab al-Hind only; Sachau's two-volume English translation and its Arabic source edition are separate bodies.

original_route.candidate: Sachau's Arabic edition remains to be located in a stable institutional scan.

english_route.candidate: Edward C. Sachau, Alberuni's India, two-volume 1910 printing.

records.next_action: Inspect both English volumes and bind them to the exact Sachau Arabic edition used.

findings.proposition: Open Library identifies Sachau and the 1910 Alberuni's India edition record.
The two English volumes must be inspected together before any complete-work coverage claim.

unresolved_risks: Open Library metadata does not itself establish file rights.
Original-language alignment is unresolved.

records.title: Rajatarangini
records.corpus_boundary: Kalhana's eight books only; later Rajatarangini continuations are excluded. Stein's Sanskrit text, translation, notes, and maps are distinct layers.

original_route.candidate: Stein's Sanskrit critical text in the complete two-volume 1900 edition, pending scan inspection.

english_route.candidate: M. A. Stein, Kalhana's Rajatarangini, volumes 1–2, 1900.

records.next_action: Inspect both DjVu volumes and confirm Sanskrit/translation pagination and license metadata.

findings.proposition: Wikisource identifies Stein as translator, the 1900 London edition, DjVu source format, and a two-volume set.
The edition's contents distinguish author, sources, textual constitution, and chronology apparatus from the translated chronicle.

unresolved_risks: Wikisource transcription is not proofread and must not replace the scan silently.
Volume 2 remains separately inspectable.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: Zizhi Tongjian
records.corpus_boundary: The 294-juan principal chronicle; tables, critical analysis, later commentaries, and modern punctuation are separately modeled.

original_route.candidate: Chinese Text Project scan/transcription route for identity inspection only; reusable bulk body not established.

records.next_action: Locate a complete institutional scan with explicit reuse terms and enumerate all 294 juan.

findings.proposition: CText describes the principal text as a 294-scroll chronological narrative and distinguishes supplementary sections.
CText's FAQ denies blanket republication and forbids automated bulk download.

unresolved_risks: CText is not an admissible bulk source under its stated terms.
No complete English body is known.
No file has been inspected or admitted.

records.title: The Canterbury Tales
records.corpus_boundary: Chaucer's unfinished Tales in an explicit editorial order; manuscript variants and the non-Chaucerian Tale of Gamelyn are excluded unless separately modeled.

original_route.candidate: Walter W. Skeat, Chaucer's Works volume 4, Middle English, Project Gutenberg ebook 22120.

english_route.candidate: No modern-English body proposed; Middle English remains the authoritative admission candidate.

records.next_action: Inspect Gutenberg 22120 and encode Skeat order, unfinished passages, and Gamelyn exclusion.

findings.proposition: Gutenberg identifies ebook 22120 as Skeat's Middle English edition and states public-domain status in the United States.
The British Library catalogs Lansdowne MS 851 as a copy made shortly after Chaucer's death and records its tale sequence, including Gamelyn.

unresolved_risks: Skeat's editorial order is not a recovered authorial order.
Gamelyn attribution must remain excluded or disputed.
No file has been inspected or admitted.
